integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action, cinematic with an ARRI Alexa 35mm character, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, and restrained warm color grading matching the reference bedroom's daylight. The frame opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a tidy suburban master bedroom seen at eye level from the foot and side of the bed — dark-wood bed with a textured cream duvet and white pillows running toward the rear windows, a dark-wood dresser with an arched mirror and scattered toiletries on the left wall, a dark-wood nightstand in the right foreground holding a brass lamp with a cream shade on a small green mat, three rear windows with white plantation shutters partially open beneath a muted olive-green patterned valance, and a silver-and-black stationary exercise bike standing in front of the middle window on light beige carpet beneath a vaulted beige ceiling. Soft daylight filters through the shutter slats; dust motes drift in the warm air. No one is visible. The camera holds near the first-frame framing with only a subtle handheld micro-sway at slow speed, keeping the shot alive without changing composition. At around 3 seconds, a middle-aged East Asian woman in a light blouse, high-waisted trousers, and soft indoor slippers enters from the right edge of frame carrying a small folded throw blanket, her appearance fully clothed, modest, and entirely non-sexualized. The handheld unit follows her at eye level with a slight natural shake as she walks at a calm everyday pace to the bed, lays the blanket neatly at the foot of the cream duvet, and smooths a pillow with both hands, her expression relaxed and focused on tidying, with natural motion blur on her limbs and fabric, realistic weight, authentic skin texture, and natural eye catchlights. At around 7 seconds, she steps past the foot of the bed toward the rear windows and gently tilts one plantation-shutter slat open to admit a bit more daylight; she then wipes the exercise bike's handlebar with a small cloth from her pocket and checks the seat height with one hand, the bike otherwise untouched — practical domestic chores only, never athletic or dramatic. At around 11 seconds, she moves to the dresser mirror, briefly checks her collar and hair in a matter-of-fact way, picks up a small bottle from the dresser top and sets it back aligned with the others, then exits calmly toward the right doorway. As she leaves, the camera settles back into the exact first-frame composition: the room unchanged except for the folded throw remaining on the bed and slightly brighter light near the shutters. No on-screen text, logos, or watermarks appear at any point.

overall_soundscape: Soft room tone with faint outdoor daylight ambience and the gentle rustle of fabric as the woman walks and folds the blanket. The shutter slat makes a light wooden click, a cloth squeaks faintly on the bike handlebar, small bottles clink softly on the dresser, and quiet slippered footsteps cross the carpet before the room returns to stillness.
